Type: microsim **sim-id:** predator-prey
**Library:** p5.js
**Status:** Reused
**Source:** https://dmccreary.github.io/ecology/sims/predator-prey/main.html
**Source Repo:** https://github.com/dmccreary/ecology/tree/main/docs/sims/predator-prey Reused from the cross-book MicroSim catalog (WHAT match score 0.7805, verified live). An interactive MicroSim modeling Lotka-Volterra predator-prey oscillations with an animated meadow and real-time population graphs. Learning objective: given the animated predator and prey populations, the learner will explain why the two populations oscillate out of phase over time in a balancing feedback system (Bloom: Understanding).
